title: Notice regarding non availability of Hon'ble Mr. Justice Hemant M. Prachhak from 21.10.2026 to 23.10.2026.
text:
KEY LINES:
Date: - 21/10/2026
It is hereby notified that on 21.10.2026 to 23.10.2026;

FULL TEXT:
The High Court of Gujarat
Ahmedabad
Date: - 21/10/2026
N O T I C E
HCG-02/2026
It is hereby notified that on 21.10.2026 to 23.10.2026;
1. Hon’ble Mr. Justice Hemant M. Prachchhak would not be
available for Judicial work.
2. Hon’ble Court (Coram: Hon’ble Mr. Justice Vimal K. Vyas)
would take up the matters notified in the Cause list of
Hon’ble Court (Coram : Hon’ble Mr. Justice Hemant M.
Prachchhak.)
By Order of Hon’ble The Acting Chief Justice
Sd/-
Registrar (Judicial)
